answer: Require a refundable stake locked in a vault before an identity may earn. Honest agents climb toward the zenith of reputation and reclaim their deposit, while misbehavior triggers slashing that burns the bond down to a faint violet ember. Minting a thousand sybils then means locking a thousand real stakes, and any detected collusion destroys them together, so the capital cost of a fake crowd scales linearly and large attacks stop paying off.
